{"name":"pr4f/mvar-metrics","commit":{"sha":"467e5b4819173b72c2fa49bc3f68e0a0ee36aa6f","node_id":"C_kwDOAORW-9oAKDQ2N2U1YjQ4MTkxNzNiNzJjMmZhNDliYzNmNjhlMGEwZWUzNmFhNmY","commit":{"author":{"name":"Benedikt Stebner","email":"Gillibald@users.noreply.github.com","date":"2026-06-03T11:00:24Z"},"committer":{"name":"Benedikt Stebner","email":"Gillibald@users.noreply.github.com","date":"2026-09-29T13:47:42Z"},"message":"Add MVAR for variation-aware font-wide metrics

GlyphTypeface.Metrics on a varied typeface now reflects the variation
point: ascender, descender, line gap, underline thickness/position,
and strikeout thickness/position can each carry a per-axis delta. For
fonts where these metrics vary substantially (e.g. opsz axis on optical-
size fonts, where ascent/descent change meaningfully across sizes),
text layout that consults Metrics gets the right values.

For fonts like Inter Variable that hold ascent/descent/line gap
constant across the weight axis, only the metrics that actually vary
(underline + strikeout sizes and positions) are affected — others
inherit the source's default-instance value via the "missing record
returns no delta" semantics.

New MvarTable parser under Tables/Variation:
- Header parsing with proper layout: majorVersion, minorVersion,
  reserved, valueRecordSize, valueRecordCount, itemVariationStoreOffset
  (the reserved field is a real 16-bit slot in MVAR's header, not the
  packing detail one might assume — a draft of this PR initially missed
  it and read every subsequent field at the wrong offset).
- ValueRecord array decoded into a Dictionary<OpenTypeTag, (outer, inner)>
  for O(1) tag lookups.
- Wraps the embedded ItemVariationStore (shared infrastructure from pr4d).
- TryGetMetricDelta(tag, activeCoords, out delta) returns the delta for
  a given tag; false when the font doesn't declare a record for it
  (which is fine — that metric is constant across axis space).
- MvarTags companion class with the seven well-known tags this PR maps
  to FontMetrics fields: hasc, hdsc, hlgp, unds, undo, strs, stro.

GlyphTypeface wiring:
- Source ctor loads _mvarTable alongside the other variation tables.
- Clone ctor reference-shares the table and builds its FontMetrics
  via ApplyMvarDeltas — a new private static helper that walks each
  known tag, applies the delta with the correct sign convention
  (Avalonia stores Ascent/Descent/UnderlinePosition/StrikethroughPosition
  negated relative to the OpenType raw values, so those tags get
  subtracted; LineGap and thicknesses are added as-is), and returns a
  new FontMetrics record.

The clone's variation coords need to be projected inside the clone
ctor itself, which runs before _activeCoords is assigned — so
ApplyMvarDeltas does its own one-shot stackalloc projection. The
field's then populated later in the constructor for the gvar / HVAR
hot paths.

Tested with 13 new tests:
- MvarTableTests (6): static-font rejection, variable-font load,
  axis-count mismatch, Inter Variable's 5 records exactly (stro / strs
  / undo / unds / xhgt), tags Inter doesn't declare return false,
  zero-delta at default variation.
- GlyphTypefaceMvarMetricsTests (7): static-font no-regression, source
  metrics at default instance, underline + strikeout thickness grow
  with weight, ascent/descent/line gap unchanged across Inter weights
  (verifies the missing-record fallback), default-variation clone
  returns source, intermediate weight has intermediate metrics.

All 508 Media tests + 9 render tests still
